artifact_exclusions: No raw log, source, overlay, binary, source inventory, or raw event rows in the archive. Normalize only numerical summary/outcomes and provenance hashes.

No controller polling added by trace; existing controller reads alone determine hold. Instrumentation still affects host execution and goroutine scheduling, so traced throughput is diagnostic, not acceptance.
Initial trace capture begins3.5s after first service event; absence of abort is only asserted for captured interval.
No gate changes, no production fix, no claimed full closure of long throughput failure.
bounded_trace_policy: Aggregate event counts and a finite scalar causal excerpt are retained. Raw event rows, detailed trace contexts, source, overlays, binaries, manifests, and logs remain local.
classification: failure/design diagnostic evidence; no production candidate, performance acceptance, or closure claim
scope: Numerical diagnostic trace plus deterministic sampler failure-before; no production fix or performance acceptance.
